DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。展示で何を体験したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to try at the exhibit?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このボタンを押して動きを見たいです。隣の展示と同じように自分で操作してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 隣の展示と同じようにボタンを自由操作できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to press this button and watch it move. May I operate it myself like the exhibit next to it?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can operate the button freely like the neighboring exhibit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは係員が実演する展示です。札に係員専用とあり、自由操作の展示ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This exhibit is demonstrated by staff. The sign says staff only; it isn't a hands-on exhibit.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 隣にボタンがあるので同じだと思いました。こちらは触らず、実演を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ方式と誤解したと認め、係員専用は触らず実演を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought they were the same because there was a button next to it. I won't touch this one and would like to watch the demonstration.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Admit mistaking the operating method and say you won't touch staff-only equipment but want to watch the demonstration. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 次の実演は五分後です。隣の体験用展示は、そちらの手順を読んで利用できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The next demonstration is in five minutes. You can use the neighboring hands-on exhibit after reading its instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二つの利用方法を分けます。実演を見てから、体験用の札に従って試したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実演後に体験用だけを案内に従って使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll distinguish how to use the two. After watching the demonstration, I'd like to try the hands-on one following its sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that after the demonstration you will use only the hands-on exhibit following its instructions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その順序でご覧ください。実演の装置へ荷物を置かないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please view them in that order. Don't put your belongings on the demonstration equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物は自分で持ちます。見学だけの装置を体験用と混同しないよう、札の色も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を持ち、係員専用と体験用を札でも区別すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll keep my belongings with me. I'll check the sign colors too, so I don't confuse observation-only equipment with the hands-on exhibit.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will carry your belongings and distinguish staff-only and hands-on exhibits by their signs too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの赤い札は係員専用、隣の青い札は体験用の案内です。色だけでなく文も読んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: This red sign means staff only; the blue sign next door has hands-on instructions. Please read the text, not just the colors.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 赤青の文も読みました。まず実演を見て、あとで青い案内の展示だけを手順どおり試します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札の文を読み、実演見学後に体験用のみ手順に従うと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've read both the red and blue signs. I'll watch the demonstration first and later try only the blue-sign exhibit according to its procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm reading the signs and following the procedure only for the hands-on exhibit after watching the demonstration. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まもなく実演を始めます。見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll begin the demonstration shortly. Please enjoy watching.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご注文について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help with your order?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: うどんはもう買いましたが、天ぷらだけ追加したいです。うどんをもう一度注文せずに買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入済みうどんは再注文せず、天ぷらだけ追加購入できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've already bought udon but would like to add just tempura. Can I buy it without ordering udon again?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to buy only additional tempura without reordering udon already purchased. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追加の天ぷらだけを別に会計できます。前のうどんは、どちらに置いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can pay separately just for the extra tempura. Where is your earlier udon?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 席で友人に見ていてもらっています。食べかけの丼を売場の列へ持って来てはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 丼は席で友人が見ており、食べかけを列へ持込んでいないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: At my seat, with my friend looking after it. I haven't brought the partly eaten bowl into the sales queue.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend is watching the bowl at your seat and you haven't brought partly eaten food into the queue. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追加購入はこちらの列の最後尾からお願いします。空のトレーを一つ使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please join the back of this queue for an additional purchase. You can use one empty tray.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最後尾に並びます。先ほど来たからと、ほかのお客様より先に会計してもらうつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最後尾に並び、既に一度利用したから優先会計を求めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll join the back. I don't intend to ask to pay ahead of other customers just because I've already been here once.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will join the back and won't seek checkout priority because you used the shop earlier. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。天ぷらは何をいくつ追加しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. What tempura and how many would you like to add?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この野菜の天ぷらを一つだけです。うどんや飲み物は追加しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 野菜天ぷら一つのみで、うどん飲物は追加しないと注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just one of these vegetable tempura. No extra udon or drinks.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Order one vegetable tempura only, with no udon or drinks added. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 天ぷら一つだけですね。先ほどの食事とは別のお会計で、控えも別にお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Just one tempura, then. It will be paid separately from your earlier meal, with a separate receipt too.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 天ぷらだけの金額を確認して支払います。二枚の控えは、それぞれの買物のものとして保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加分だけの金額を確認し、二枚の控えを別購入として保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the amount for just the tempura and pay. I'll keep both receipts as records of their respective purchases.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the extra amount only and keep the two receipts as separate purchases. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。追加分の控えをお渡しします。どうぞお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Here is the extra purchase receipt. Please enjoy your meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。相談の連絡について何を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about contact regarding your inquiry?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相談フォームからメールが来ました。これで質問への回答が済んだのか、文面を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談フォームのメールが質問への回答か文面確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received an email from the consultation form. I'd like to check the wording to see whether my question has now been answered.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check whether the consultation-form email answers your question. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは受信したという自動通知です。ご相談の内容への回答ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is an automatic acknowledgment of receipt. It isn't an answer to the substance of your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受信しましたという文を、解決しましたという意味だと思っていました。まだ質問の答えはないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受信通知を解決済みと誤読したと認め、まだ回答がないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought 'received' meant 'resolved.' So there isn't an answer to my question yet, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Admit reading receipt notification as resolution and confirm there is no answer yet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。受付番号で担当の確認状況を照会できます。もう同じ内容を送り直しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. You can inquire about the staff's review status using the reference number. Have you already resent the same message?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。回答がないから何件も送る前に、一件の受付があるか聞きたくて来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再送未実施で、複数送信前に一件の受付を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. Before sending multiple copies because there's no answer, I came to check whether one inquiry had been received.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you haven't resent it and want to confirm one received inquiry before submitting duplicates. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この番号の相談を受け付けています。回答の連絡先は入力されたメールです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have received the inquiry with this number. The response will go to the email address entered.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付一件とメールの連絡先を確認しました。迷惑メールの欄も見ますが、答えがあったとは思いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付一件とメール先を確認し、迷惑メールも調べるが回答済みとは考えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've confirmed one inquiry and the contact email. I'll also check the spam folder, but I won't assume there has been an answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm one received inquiry and the email address, and say you'll check spam without assuming it has been answered. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 期限のある通知についての相談なら、その期限も担当に伝える必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If your inquiry concerns a notice with a deadline, you also need to tell the staff that deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相談した通知の期限を追加で担当へ伝えます。自動返信だけで期限の扱いが変わったとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知期限を担当へ追加で伝え、自動通知だけで期限変更と考えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll additionally tell the staff the deadline on the notice I asked about. I won't assume the automatic reply alone changes how the deadline applies.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will add the notice deadline for the staff and won't assume automatic acknowledgment changes it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。受付番号に沿って担当へ確認します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-KITAKAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check with the staff using your reference number. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。作業について何か相談がありますか。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything you want to discuss about the work?

DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 出荷用の箱の底にひびを見つけました。写真を班のチャットに送りましたが、そのまま出荷してよいか返事がありません。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 箱の底のひびを写真送信したが出荷可否の返事がないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a crack in the bottom of a shipping box. I sent a photo to the team chat but haven't received an answer about whether it can be shipped as it is.
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report sending a photo of a crack in the box bottom without receiving shipping approval. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真を送っただけでは出荷してよいという確認にはなりません。箱はいまどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sending a photo alone doesn't confirm shipping is allowed. Where is the box now?

DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二番の出荷台の端です。ほかの箱へ積み重ねず、見つけた場所に置いています。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 破損箱は二番出荷台の端にあり積み重ねていないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the edge of shipping platform two. I haven't stacked it on other boxes; it's where I found it.
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the damaged box is at the edge of shipping platform two and isn't stacked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 責任者の確認を受けましょう。チャットの送信先は責任者も含む班のグループですか。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's have the supervisor check. Is the chat group you sent it to a team group including the supervisor?

DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、でも未読です。急ぐトラックが来たので、口頭でも知らせたくてここへ来ました。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 責任者を含む未読の班チャットへ送ったが運転手到着で口頭報告に来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, but it's unread. The truck is here and in a hurry, so I came to report it verbally too.
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain sending to an unread team chat including the supervisor and coming to report verbally after the driver's arrival. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらから責任者へ連絡します。確認前に箱を持ち上げたり、中身を別箱へ移したりしないでください。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll contact the supervisor. Before the check, don't lift the box or transfer its contents into another one.

DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。運転手には私が出荷可否を決めるのではなく、責任者の確認待ちと伝えます。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分で出荷可否を決めず運転手へ責任者確認待ちと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll tell the driver we're waiting for the supervisor's check rather than deciding myself whether it can ship.
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you won't decide shipping approval yourself and will tell the driver the supervisor's check is pending. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 責任者が出荷台へ向かうと返事がありました。到着するまで、位置を説明できるよう待ってください。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-09.translation: The supervisor replied that they're heading to the platform. Please wait and be ready to explain its location when they arrive.

DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二番台の端で待ち、ひびの位置を示します。写真送信済みでも、現物の確認はまだだと引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出荷台でひび位置を示し写真送信と現物確認の進み具合を区別して引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait at the edge of platform two and point out the crack. I'll hand over that the photo has been sent but the actual item hasn't been checked yet.
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Point out the crack at the shipping platform and distinguish photo submission from actual-item inspection in the handover. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。出荷の扱いは責任者の確認後に決めます。報告ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-IWT-MIYAKO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The shipping decision will be made after the supervisor checks. Thank you for reporting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約した遊覧船が欠航と聞きました。今日しか時間がないので、別の日へ予約を移すより支払いの扱いを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今日のみ滞在のため欠航予約の変更でなく支払いの扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard the sightseeing boat I reserved was canceled. I only have time today, so I'd like to discuss the payment rather than move the reservation to another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about payment handling rather than changing a canceled reservation because you are only staying today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約番号を拝見します。予約は二人分ですね。お支払いはこの窓口でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the reservation number. It's for two people, correct? Did you pay at this counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二人分ですが、旅行の予約サイトで払いました。この窓口で買い直した物はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人分を予約サイトで支払い窓口購入分はないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: For two, but I paid on a travel booking website. I haven't bought any replacement tickets at this counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain paying for two through a booking site and having no counter-purchased tickets. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 払戻しの扱いは購入した窓口へ確認する必要があります。こちらでは欠航の案内をお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to check refund handling with the place of purchase. We can give you the cancellation notice here.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ではその案内をいただきます。別のサイトで今日の同じ船を買い直しても、運航が戻るわけではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 欠航案内を求め同じ船の買い直しでは運航が戻らないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'd like that notice. Buying today's same boat again on a different site wouldn't make the service resume, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request the cancellation notice and confirm that repurchasing the same boat won't restore service. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、今日の欠航案内は同じです。午後の予定はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct, today's cancellation information remains the same. Have you made afternoon plans?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午後四時に町を出ます。同行者と岸にある展示を見て過ごしたいので、場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 午後四時出発まで岸の展示を同行者と見たいので入口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: We leave town at four in the afternoon. I'd like to spend the time viewing the shore-side exhibition with my companion, so please tell me where it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the exhibition entrance so you can view it ashore with your companion before leaving at four. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 展示の入口はこちらです。船の乗場へ再集合する必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The exhibition entrance is here. You don't need to gather at the boat boarding point again.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 欠航案内を持って予約サイトへ支払いを相談します。今日は乗船せず、四時の出発まで同行者と展示を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を使い購入先へ相談し今日は展示を見ると選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the cancellation notice and discuss payment with the booking site. We won't board today; we'll view the exhibition together until our four-o'clock departure.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose to consult the seller using the notice and view the exhibition today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご希望の乗船ができず申し訳ありません。どうぞこちらの案内をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'm sorry you can't take the boat you wanted. Please use this information.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。今日は何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help today?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 十キロの米を予約しましたが、自転車で来ました。この大きな袋をかごへ載せるのは難しそうです。受取りを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約した十キロの米を自転車で運べず受取方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I reserved ten kilograms of rice but came by bicycle. This large bag looks difficult to put in the basket. I'd like to discuss collection.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to collect ten kilograms of reserved rice you can't transport by bicycle. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お品物はご用意しています。五キロずつに分けることはできますが、追加の袋は有料です。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's ready. We can divide it into five-kilogram portions, but the extra bags cost money.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二袋にしても十キロを一度に運ぶことに変わりないので、自転車で無理に帰りたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小分けしても総重量が同じなので自転車で無理に運ばないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Even with two bags, I'd still be carrying ten kilograms at once, so I don't want to force myself to ride home with it.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that splitting the load doesn't change total weight and you won't force yourself to transport it by bicycle. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の受取方法にされますか。本日中のお取り置きでしたら可能です。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you prefer another collection method? We can hold it until later today.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人が夕方に車で迎えに来られるそうです。五時までその一袋を置いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の車を使うため五時まで取り置きを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: A friend says they can pick me up by car this evening. Could you keep the single bag until five?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to hold it until five so you can use your friend's car. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 五時までお取り置きします。車ではご本人も一緒に来られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll hold it until five. Will you also come in the car yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、私も一緒です。友人に購入代金を預けて代理受取りしてもらうのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人だけの代理受取でなく本人も車で来ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'll come too. I won't entrust the purchase money to my friend and have them collect it on my behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will also come by car rather than have your friend collect it alone as a representative. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では元の十キロ一袋のまま、お客様のご来店をお待ちします。小分けの袋は追加しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we'll keep the original single ten-kilogram bag and wait for you. We won't add any portioning bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その内容でお願いします。自転車では持ち帰らず、五時に友人の車で来て自分が受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十キロ一袋のまま夕方車で本人が受け取ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please. I won't take it home by bicycle; I'll come in my friend's car at five and collect it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm collection of the single ten-kilogram bag yourself by car in the evening. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。夕方お待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We look forward to seeing you this evening.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご注文で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Can I help with your order?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 焼き魚の定食を子どもと分けたいです。魚は骨を取った状態で出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもと分けたい焼き魚が骨を除いた状態で出るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to share the grilled-fish set with my child. Is the fish served with its bones removed?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the grilled fish you want to share with your child comes deboned. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切身でお出ししますが、骨が残っている場合があります。骨が全くないとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's served as a fillet, but some bones may remain. We can't guarantee it's entirely boneless.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 子どもはまだ自分で骨を見つけて取れません。私が大急ぎで分けるより、子どもには別の料理を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子どもは骨を取れないため分けず別料理にしたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My child can't find and remove bones yet. Rather than divide it in a hurry myself, I'd like to choose another dish for my child.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your child cannot remove bones and you want a separate dish rather than sharing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お子様向けに小さい卵料理のご飯があります。食材について確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have a small rice dish with an egg preparation for children. Is there anything you want to check about the ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 卵は食べられます。子どもの分は、その小さいご飯を一つお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 卵を食べられると答え子ども用の小さいご飯を注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My child can eat eggs. One of those small rice dishes for my child, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your child can eat eggs and order the small rice dish. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お客様の分は、焼き魚定食をそのまま注文されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like to keep the grilled-fish set for yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、魚は私が食べます。子どもの料理を先に出せるなら、待っている間に食べ始めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分は魚定食にし子どもの料理を先に出せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'll eat the fish. If my child's dish can be served first, we'd like to start eating while we wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the fish set for yourself and ask whether the child's dish can be served first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 先にできた料理からお出しします。焼き魚定食一つと、小さい卵料理のご飯一つですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll serve dishes as they're ready. One grilled-fish set and one small rice dish with egg, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その二品でお願いします。魚を子どもと分ける注文ではなく、それぞれの料理にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: それぞれの二品を注文し魚の取り分けはしないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Those two, please. We'll each have our own dish, rather than an order for sharing the fish with my child.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the two separate dishes and that you won't share the fish. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。出来上がり次第お持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We'll bring them as soon as they're ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。映画のご予約で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your film booking?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と二人で見ます。友人は通路側、私はその隣に座りたいのですが、この画面でどの席を選べばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人が通路側で本人が隣という二席の選び方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two of us will watch. My friend wants an aisle seat and I'd like the seat beside it. Which seats should I select on this screen?
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to select two seats with your friend on the aisle and you next to them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の回は通路側が一席空いていますが、その隣は予約済みです。二人並ぶ席なら次の回を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This showing has one aisle seat free, but the adjacent seat is booked. We can check the next showing for two seats together.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 離れて座るより、次の回を見たいです。友人の帰りの予定に合うか、終了時刻も見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 離席でなく次の回を選ぶため終了予定を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd prefer the next showing rather than sitting apart. Please also show the finishing time so I can check it fits my friend's return plans.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the finishing time so you can choose the next showing rather than separate seats. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 次の回は午後六時に終わる予定です。通路側と隣の二席が今は空いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The next showing is scheduled to finish at six p.m. An aisle seat and the seat beside it are currently free.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人へ確認したら六時終了でよいそうです。今の一席の選択をやめて、次の回の二席を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の六時終了了承を得て現回の一席をやめ次回の二席を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've checked with my friend, and a six-o'clock finish is fine. I'll deselect the single seat for this showing and choose the two seats for the next one.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Get your friend's agreement to the six-o'clock finish, deselect the current showing's one seat, and choose two for the next. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次の回のＢ一とＢ二ですね。まだお支払い前なので、決済内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's B1 and B2 for the next showing. You haven't paid yet, so please check the payment details.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: Ｂ一が通路側で友人、Ｂ二が私です。作品名と日時も、この二枚の内容で合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: Ｂ一を友人Ｂ二を本人として作品と日時も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: B1 is the aisle seat for my friend, and B2 is mine. The title, date, and time for these two tickets are correct too.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm B1 for your friend and B2 for you along with the title, date, and time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その内容で購入しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like to purchase those tickets?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、二枚購入します。友人へ座席番号と六時の終了予定を送り、入口で一緒に入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚購入し座席と終了予定を友人へ伝えて一緒に入ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, two tickets. I'll send my friend the seats and six-o'clock scheduled finish, and we'll enter together at the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy two tickets, tell your friend the seats and scheduled finish, and say you will enter together. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの確認内容を保存してご来場ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Save these confirmation details and bring them when you visit. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご相談のことで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 交通関係の書類相談を予約しましたが、控えに住所変更とあります。実際は外国の免許について相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 控えの住所変更ではなく外国免許相談へ用件を訂正したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I booked a consultation about driving-related documents, but the confirmation says address change. I actually want advice about a foreign driver's license.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to correct the purpose from address change on the confirmation to a foreign-license consultation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約番号を確認します。住所変更の相談ではなく、外国の免許に関する相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the booking number. It's about a foreign driver's license, not changing your address, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。日本の免許はまだ持っていません。控えの住所変更という用件では、準備する資料が違うと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日本免許は持っておらず誤記用件では資料が違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I don't have a Japanese license yet. I think the documents needed differ from those for the address-change purpose on the confirmation.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have no Japanese license and the incorrectly recorded purpose would need different documents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 用件の変更ができるか担当へ照会します。自己判断で新しい予約を重ねる前に、この予約を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the staff whether the purpose can be changed. Let's check this booking before you make duplicate reservations on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。今の予約を残したまま用件を伝え直し、担当が違うなら相談先も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重複予約を作らず現在の予約用件と担当先を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'd like to restate the purpose while keeping the current booking, and ask where to consult if a different department handles it.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the current booking purpose and responsible department without making duplicates. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 外国の免許については専門の案内先があります。こちらでは変更を確定せず、その担当への確認方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: There's a specialist information contact for foreign licenses. Rather than confirm a change here, we'll explain how to check with that department.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今ある外国の免許証の種類と発行国を伝えます。翻訳や追加書類を何にするかは、担当の説明を聞いてから準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発行国と資料種類を伝え翻訳等の必要物は専門担当へ確認してから準備すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll explain the type of foreign license I have and its issuing country. I'll prepare translations and extra documents after hearing the specialist's explanation of what's needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will give the issuing country and document type and prepare translations and other requirements after checking with the specialist. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。こちらが照会の案内です。元の予約の扱いも、用件訂正の確認結果を聞いてからお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Here are the inquiry instructions. Please also decide what to do with the original booking after hearing the result of the purpose-correction check.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内先へ外国の免許の相談だと伝え、元の予約の扱いと必要資料を確認します。住所変更の手続きは進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内先で元予約と必要資料を照会し住所変更として進めないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell the contact it's about a foreign license and check the original booking and necessary documents. I won't proceed with an address change.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the indicated contact about the original booking and required documents and won't proceed as an address change. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。用件を整理したメモもお渡しします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll also give you a note organizing the purpose. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 団体の案内紙を配っていましたが、風で二枚飛んでしまいました。これ以上飛ばさないよう、配る場所を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 強風で二枚の案内紙が飛んだため配布場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was handing out our group's information sheets, but two blew away. I'd like to discuss where to hand them out so no more blow away.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the distribution location because strong wind blew away two information sheets. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 残りの紙は箱へしまってください。どこへ飛んだか見えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please put the remaining papers in the box. Did you see where they went?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一枚は階段の下、もう一枚は柵の向こうです。柵を越えて取りに行ってはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二枚の飛んだ位置を説明し柵内へ回収に入っていないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One below the stairs and one beyond the fence. I haven't climbed over the fence to retrieve it.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where both sheets went and that you haven't entered beyond the fence to collect them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。回収は係員へお知らせください。配布は入口横の屋内スペースへ移せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. Please notify staff about retrieving them. Distribution can move to the indoor space beside the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では主催者へ屋内へ移すと連絡します。ここにいる参加者にも、入口横で受け取ってほしいと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 主催者と参加者へ屋内配布への変更を伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll tell the organizer we're moving indoors. I'll also tell the participants here to collect their sheets beside the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the organizer and participants about moving distribution indoors. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご案内ください。資料の箱や看板を移す間、誰が参加者へ声をかけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please guide them. While the document box and sign are being moved, who will direct the participants?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私が案内します。同僚が箱を運び、看板は倒れそうなので二人で係員の案内に従って移します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の参加者案内と同僚の箱運搬と看板移動の分担を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll guide them. My coworker will carry the box, and since the sign looks liable to fall, the two of us will move it following staff guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your participant guidance, your coworker's box transport, and the shared sign movement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。飛んだ二枚の位置も記録しました。柵の向こうはご自身で取りに行かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I've recorded the locations of both blown sheets too. Please don't go beyond the fence to collect one yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 配布を止め、紙を箱へしまいました。参加者は屋内へ案内し、飛んだ紙の回収は係員へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙をしまい参加者を屋内へ案内し危険区域の回収は係員へ頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've stopped distribution and put the papers in the box. I'll direct participants indoors and ask staff to retrieve the blown sheets.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have packed the papers away, will guide participants indoors, and will leave retrieval in the unsafe area to staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。安全な場所へ移動してから配布を再開してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please resume distribution after moving to a safe place.
